hotels.title: Adults-Only Crete Beachfront Indulgence with Three Pools & Award-Winning Spa
hotels.description: Perched on the northern coast of Crete, Domes Noruz Chania, Autograph Collection is a boutique adults-only resort that has carved out an excellent reputation. Start your day with morning yoga, soak up the Meditterranean sun on the beach, lounge by one of three pools or indulge at Soma Spa. When golden hour strikes, sunset poolside parties, live music, DJ sets and beach gatherings create the nights Chania is celebrated for. Warm earthy tones, blue palettes and timber accents create magical interiors, with private plunge pools and hammocks elevating your stay. Alongside a curated Greek wine list, Topos delivers award-winning neo-Greek seafood that takes Cretan produce seriously. The Raw Bar handles cocktails and champagne with the same care.

hotels.vendor_name: Domes Zeen Chania, a Luxury Collection Resort
hotels.title: Tranquil Crete Bungalows and Suites with Private Beach, Outdoor Pools & Onsite Dining
hotels.description: Set on the sun-drenched coast of Crete, Domes Zeen Chania is a resort built around the philosophy _Ef Zeen:_ the Greek art of living well. This oasis weaves stone pathways, lush tropical gardens and earthy natural textures into a relaxing escape. Drift between two sparkling pools or claim a sun lounger on the resort's private Blue Flag beach and let the Aegean do the rest. Soma Spa offers personalised wellness journeys rooted in ancient Cretan traditions, from rituals using local honey and olive oil to bespoke treatments designed to genuinely restore. Suites and bungalows are dressed in warm natural materials and boast private terraces that open onto gardens or sweeping sea views. Indulge in delicious neo-Greek cuisine that turns Crete's extraordinary produce into sensational dishes, then visit the beachfront Zamāna Beach Bar Restaurant for elevated coastal plates and world-class cocktails.
